recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中有大型漿細胞，細胞質充滿桃紅色物質並向周邊延伸成火焰狀邊緣（flame cell），另見雙核漿細胞與大型嗜伊紅性細胞質球狀包涵物，符合漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Plasma cells of varying size with eccentric round nuclei and clumped chromatin
Large flame cells with magenta-pink cytoplasm and irregular frayed borders
Large round pink cytoplasmic globules pushing the nucleus to the periphery (Russell-body-like inclusions)
Background small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors and poorly spread red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increase in plasma cells of varying size admixed with small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors. Several plasma cells have abundant magenta cytoplasm with ragged peripheral fringes (flame cells), and occasional binucleate forms are present. A large cell contains a voluminous homogeneous pink cytoplasmic globule that compresses the nucleus to one pole, consistent with immunoglobulin inclusion (Russell body). Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm showing flame cell morphology and immunoglobulin inclusions.

ddx.vs: Reactive states can show flame and Mott cells, but plasma cells remain polytypic by flow or IHC, whereas this case shows kappa restriction with aberrant CD20/CD200.
Storage histiocytes have striated or fibrillary pale cytoplasm and central small nuclei rather than eccentric plasma cell nuclei with magenta cytoplasm.
LPL shows a mixture of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with Dutcher bodies and an IgM paraprotein, not a predominance of large atypical plasma cells.
